How Much Does It Cost to Build a Deck?

The average cost to build a deck ranges from $4,000 to $14,000, with most homeowners spending around $8,200 for a mid-sized wooden deck. Depending on the materials, size, and extras, the average deck installation costs between $30 and $60 per square foot.

Regional variations can be significant: decks cost 15-25% more in the Northeast and West Coast than the national average.
